Security

# Security engineered for the enterprise

Protect your contract data at every layer while maintaining control. Luminance combines robust security controls with independently assessed security practices.

[Visit the trust center](https://trust.luminance.com/)

security by design

### Security built into every layer

Contracts contain some of an organization’s most sensitive information. Luminance embeds security across the platform, from infrastructure and encryption to access controls, monitoring and secure development.

Encrypted at every stage

Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Luminance uses AES-256 encryption with AWS Key Management Service for data hosted in AWS with TLS 1.2 or higher for data in transit.

Granular access, controlled by you

Control who can access Luminance and what information each user can see, with configurable role-based access, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on and audit logging.

Private learning that stays private

Customer-specific learning remains private to each organization and is not shared across customers.

Trust at every layer

## Independently assessed security

ISO 27001

Luminance maintains an independently certified Information Security Management System covering the development, operation, sales, and support of its technology platform.

SOC 2 TYPE II

Luminance undergoes regular SOC 2 Type II examinations to provide ongoing independent assurance over controls related to security, availability, and confidentiality.

Independent Penetration Testing

Independent third parties regularly test the Luminance application and operational systems against evolving threats. Further information is available through the security review process.
